reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their DM (DINSTAL0002) to confirm the note: Dock 14 is now their dock for Marrow Fieldworks pickups. I told them it stays between us.

- **Shared notes:** I checked GBrain first and found nothing on Marrow Fieldworks or the dock. I didn't save the dock change there, because other people can read those notes and Hollis asked to keep it private. I told Hollis that in the reply. The only record is our DM.
- **How it was sent:** Sending it as a direct message failed with "no member DINSTAL0002", because that tool wants a member, not a DM id. So I posted the reply into the existing DM instead, and only Hollis and I can see it.
- **No other action:** Hollis said none was needed, so I took none and shared the note nowhere else.
